product_one_liner: Search a rare disease and follow sourced connections to related biology, communities, and research assets.

search_entries.label: Sickle cell anemia (HbSS)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Narrow genotype: homozygous HbS (HbSS). Distinct from broader sickle cell disease and from sickle cell trait.

search_entries.label: Sickle cell disease (broad)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Umbrella clinical category that can include HbSS, HbSC, HbS/β-thalassemia, and other genotypes.

search_entries.label: Sickle cell trait
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Carrier state (HbAS), not sickle cell disease.

search_entries.label: Beta-thalassemia (genetic)
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Genetic HBB underproduction category. Distinct from transfusion-dependence labels.

search_entries.label: Transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Clinical phenotype used in trials (transfusion dependence), not a single genotype.

search_entries.label: Beta-thalassemia major
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Clinical severity label; often transfusion-dependent, but not identical to every genetic subtype.

search_entries.label: BCL11A
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Therapeutic target for HbF reactivation in curated evidence; not the disease-causing gene for HbSS/β-thalassemia.

search_entries.label: Fetal hemoglobin (HbF) reactivation
search_entries.disambiguation_note: Shared biology bridge under investigation across SCD and β-thalassemia communities.

stages.label: Understand the connection
stages.summary: Follow HbSS to HbF/BCL11A biology and the related β-thalassemia research community.

stages.label: Explore resources
stages.summary: See studies, publications, organizations, and models linked through the HbF / BCL11A path — with reuse caveats.

stages.label: Prepare next step
stages.summary: Turn verified differences and open questions into a sourced collaboration brief.

edge_plain_language.edge:genotype:hbss:causes:disease:hbss: HbSS is the genotype that defines sickle cell anemia in this atlas.
edge_plain_language.edge:genotype:hbss:has_allele:HbS: The HbSS genotype includes two copies of the HbS allele.
edge_plain_language.edge:allele:HbS:allele_of:gene:HBB: HbS is an allele of the HBB gene (c.20A>T).
edge_plain_language.edge:mechanism:hbf:relevant:disease:hbss: Raising fetal hemoglobin is mechanistically relevant to sickle cell anemia pathophysiology.
edge_plain_language.edge:process:bcl11a:supports:mechanism:h: Disrupting BCL11A’s repression of γ-globin supports HbF reactivation.
edge_plain_language.edge:gene:BCL11A:participates:process:bc: BCL11A participates in repressing fetal hemoglobin after birth.
edge_plain_language.edge:intervention:exa_cel:targets:gene:B: exa-cel is designed to edit the BCL11A erythroid enhancer — not HBB.
edge_plain_language.edge:pmid:38661449:investigates_interven: A 2024 phase 3 publication reports exa-cel outcomes in severe sickle cell disease.
edge_plain_language.edge:pmid:38661449:reports_on_study:nct:: This publication reports results from the CLIMB SCD-121 clinical study (NCT03745287).
edge_plain_language.edge:pmid:38661449:clinical_evidence_for: Trial clinical evidence supports VOC-related outcomes in the enrolled SCD population.
edge_plain_language.edge:pmid:38657265:investigates_interven: A parallel 2024 phase 3 publication reports exa-cel in transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia.
edge_plain_language.edge:pmid:38657265:reports_on_study:nct:: This publication reports results from the CLIMB THAL-111 clinical study (NCT03655678).
edge_plain_language.edge:nct:NCT03745287:tests:intervention:: CLIMB SCD-121 is the clinical study registry record testing exa-cel in severe sickle cell disease.
edge_plain_language.edge:nct:NCT03655678:tests:intervention:: CLIMB THAL-111 is the clinical study registry record testing exa-cel in transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia.
edge_plain_language.edge:mechanism:hbf:relevant:disease:tdt: HbF reactivation is relevant to transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia endpoints in the TDT trial.
edge_plain_language.edge:hypothesis:bridge:proposed_from:mec: Shared HbF biology motivates a cross-community research bridge — still a hypothesis about asset reuse.
edge_plain_language.edge:org:scdaa:supports_community:diseas: SCDAA is a verified patient organization for the sickle cell community.
edge_plain_language.edge:org:caf:supports_community:disease:: Cooley’s Anemia Foundation is a verified patient organization for thalassemia.
edge_plain_language.edge:asset:jax_townes:model_for:disease:: The JAX Townes mouse is an experimental model developed for sickle cell disease research.
edge_plain_language.edge:asset:jax_townes:hypothesis_not_val: Suitability of the Townes SCD model for β-thalassemia is not established here.
edge_plain_language.edge:hypothesis:bridge:leads_to:question: The bridge hypothesis points to a concrete validation research question.
edge_plain_language.edge:org:caf:could_inform:question: CAF is a potential stakeholder for β-thalassemia community priorities — availability not claimed.
edge_plain_language.edge:org:scdaa:could_inform:question: SCDAA is a potential stakeholder for SCD-side priorities — availability not claimed.

asset_assessments.title: CLIMB SCD-121 study design (NCT03745287)
asset_assessments.description: Completed ClinicalTrials.gov protocol evaluating exa-cel (CTX001) in severe sickle cell disease with VOC eligibility criteria.
asset_assessments.owner: ClinicalTrials.gov public registry record (sponsors listed on record)

designed_for.disease: Severe sickle cell disease (broad SCD enrollment framing)
designed_for.genotype: Confirm genotype eligibility on the source record; do not assume HbSS-only
designed_for.population: Ages 12–35 with severe VOC history (per publication/registry)

asset_assessments.access: Public protocol metadata on ClinicalTrials.gov. Does not grant access to participant-level data.
asset_assessments.relevance_to_journey: Shows a human study design and endpoints already used for HbF/BCL11A intervention research in SCD.

may_be_reusable: Publicly described eligibility structure and VOC-related endpoints as a design reference
Documented conditioning/editing modality description for expert discussion
what_differs: SCD VOC endpoints differ from transfusion-independence endpoints used in TDT
Genotype mix in SCD trials may not equal HbSS-only populations
needs_expert_review: Whether any design element can inform a β-thalassemia collaboration without copying inapplicable eligibility
Regulatory/ethical constraints on reusing protocol language vs data
comparison.validation_question: Which SCD trial-design elements (if any) are informative for a β-thalassemia HbF research collaboration without assuming shared eligibility?

asset_assessments.title: CLIMB THAL-111 study design (NCT03655678)
asset_assessments.description: Completed ClinicalTrials.gov protocol evaluating exa-cel (CTX001) in transfusion-dependent β-thalassemia.
asset_assessments.owner: ClinicalTrials.gov public registry record (sponsors listed on record)

designed_for.genotype: β0/β0, β0/β0-like, or non–β0/β0-like as enrolled

asset_assessments.access: Public protocol metadata on ClinicalTrials.gov. Does not grant access to participant-level data.
asset_assessments.relevance_to_journey: Provides the β-thalassemia-side study design counterpart to the SCD exa-cel program.

may_be_reusable: Transfusion-independence endpoint definitions for community-facing research conversations
Public documentation of genotype strata used in TDT enrollment
what_differs: Clinical category is transfusion dependence, not every genetic β-thalassemia subtype
Not interchangeable with SCD VOC endpoint packages
needs_expert_review: How genotype strata map to a specific patient group's research question
What can be learned from public protocol vs what requires new primary research
comparison.adaptation_status: Documented for TDT; cross-use beyond that scope needs review
comparison.validation_question: Which TDT protocol fields are directly useful for the patient group's stated question, and which require new evidence?

asset_assessments.description: Transgenic mouse strain used for sickle cell disease experimental research.

designed_for.disease: Sickle cell disease / HbSS modeling context

asset_assessments.access: Commercial/academic strain catalog access pathways via JAX; verify current distribution terms.
asset_assessments.relevance_to_journey: An existing experimental asset on the SCD side of the HbF conversation.

may_be_reusable: As a reference for how SCD-focused models are documented and shared
what_differs: Animal findings are not human findings
Sickling pathophysiology ≠ ineffective erythropoiesis of β-thalassemia
needs_expert_review: Whether any assay/outcome from Townes work could inform a β-thalassemia question
Whether a different model is required instead

asset_assessments.title: SCDIC Sickle Cell Disease Patient Registry (NHLBI / BioLINCC)
asset_assessments.description: NHLBI-funded Sickle Cell Disease Implementation Consortium patient registry. BioLINCC documents an open epidemiology study collection for researcher requests of de-identified data (dataset page last updated noted at retrieval 2026-10-04). This is a patient registry / observational cohort resource — not a ClinicalTrials.gov interventional listing.
asset_assessments.owner: NHLBI / SCDIC (Data Coordinating Center historically RTI International); BioLINCC data repository listing

designed_for.disease: Sickle cell disease (broad SCD enrollment; confirmed genotypes including Hb SS and Hb Sβ-thalassemia per public protocol materials)
designed_for.genotype: Confirmed SCD genotypes as documented in registry materials; do not assume HbSS-only without checking fields
designed_for.population: SCDIC registry cohort (public materials describe adolescent/adult enrollment windows across phases)

asset_assessments.access: Researcher data access: BioLINCC registration and data-request process with IRB/data-use requirements (see BioLINCC study page). Patient enrollment is through participating centers / physician referral pathways and is not the same as researcher data access. Organization or consortium willingness to collaborate on a specific new study question is not established by the public listing alone.
asset_assessments.relevance_to_journey: Provides a verified SCD patient-registry identity with a documented researcher inquiry/access process, distinct from ClinicalTrials.gov study-design records.

may_be_reusable: Publicly documented researcher data-request pathway via BioLINCC as a process reference
Registry framing for natural-history / barriers-to-care questions in SCD communities
what_differs: Registry observational cohort ≠ interventional trial protocol package
Broad SCD genotype mix may not equal an HbSS-only community question
Patient enrollment pathways differ from researcher data access
needs_expert_review: Which BioLINCC application fields and consent constraints apply to the community question
Whether HbSS-specific analyses are supported by available genotype fields
comparison.validation_question: Which specific BioLINCC/SCDIC variables and access constraints must be confirmed before treating this registry as in-scope for the community's genotype-aware question?

registry_gap.explanation: ClinicalTrials.gov study listings are not patient registries. This curated demo now includes the NHLBI Sickle Cell Disease Implementation Consortium (SCDIC) Patient Registry, with researcher data access documented via BioLINCC. Patient enrollment, collaboration inquiries, and researcher data access are distinct processes; none of them alone proves the others. β-thalassemia-specific registry coverage remains a gap.
missing_evidence: Verified β-thalassemia–specific patient registry with a documented community inquiry pathway in this demo layer
Confirmation that any organization has agreed to collaborate on a specific cross-disease methods question
registry_gap.next_question: For a genotype-aware HbSS question, which BioLINCC/SCDIC data-request fields and consent constraints must be checked before treating the registry as in-scope — and is a separate β-thalassemia registry still required?

sources_searched: Curated HBB demonstration layer (ClinVar anchors, PubMed PMIDs 38657265/38661449, ClinicalTrials NCT03745287/NCT03655678, SCDAA, CAF, SCDIC registry via BioLINCC, JAX Townes)
unsupported_search.coverage_note: Coverage is limited to the curated HBB, ARID1B, GATA6, and ODC1 demonstration datasets in this prototype. Absence from these datasets is not evidence that no scientific connection exists.

proposal_defaults.research_question: Which HbF-pathway research assets and collaborator networks can be responsibly evaluated for β-thalassemia community needs without assuming SCD-model compatibility?
proposal_defaults.proposed_next_step: Schedule an expert review call to compare CLIMB SCD-121 and CLIMB THAL-111 public protocol fields against the patient group's genotype-aware question, and decide whether Townes (or another model) is even in scope.
proposal_defaults.partner_gap_if_unknown: No individual researcher availability or email is asserted. Use organization public contact pages after human verification.

landing_disclaimer: These hemoglobinopathy conditions already have treatments. This atlas focuses on sourced research connections and reusable assets — not treatment advice.
